The bandage is beige/tan with a textured surface and a central pad area. There is reversed text printed on the lower part of the bandage. The background shows a blurred figure, possibly wearing medical gear or a mask, suggesting a clinical or first-aid context.

The fingers holding the bandage appear somewhat fused and lack clear definition at the contact points. The thumb position looks anatomically awkward relative to the grip.
The background face and objects are heavily blurred and distorted, which may be intentional depth-of-field, but the edges near the bandage show slight bleeding/inconsistency.
